items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Ben Smith was in the band, then, too.

ctx.x: And I couldn't get out of that, and I went back and said you can't do that no more. I said, the whites -- and so, I said, well, I'll put up a sign, special party tonight, and I tried it that way and that wouldn't work. And those white kids was coming from New Haven and they wasn't going to play the (unintelligible). You can imagine what those guys -- the same (unintelligible). Ben Smith was in the band, then, too.
